doc.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995

title: Closing banter about the interview and editing
summary: Heard jokes about Red Holloway, asks how much will be edited and is told nothing.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well thanks for sharing your time with us.
This is probably most ridiculous, one you’ve done so far. Now Red Holloway, that’s you know, I’m surprised you didn’t end this ten minutes ago. It’s boring after Red Holloway, right?
He’s a corny one. Like I say, like this lady, Rosa Lopez. Her voice says, you say hear a voice? “No,” I just says “noises.”
How much of that you going to edit out?
Great. That’s great. Don’t take nothing out of there man.
What you see is what you get.
These people want you to behave.
